meta.name: wiki-builder
meta.description: Start, structure, and grow a persistent research wiki indexed in pro-workflow's SQLite knowledge base. Each wiki is a folder of markdown pages with provenance, plus a shadow FTS5 index so any session can recall it. Use when the user says "start a wiki", "add to wiki", "compile a page", "wiki on X", or wants a long-lived knowledge base on a topic, paper, product, person, project, or codebase.

copy.tagline: 创建并管理持久化研究维基
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要长期积累和检索某个主题的结构化笔记
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage a persistent research wiki
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build and query a long-lived wiki on any topic

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、整理和查询一个持久的维基知识库。每个维基是一个文件夹，包含 Markdown 页面和来源记录，并配有全文搜索索引，可在不同会话中调用。
howto.when: 当你说“开始一个维基”、“添加到维基”、“编译一个页面”、“关于 X 的维基”，或想要一个长期的知识库时触发。

say.text: 开始一个关于量子计算的维基，风格为 research。
say.note: Claude 会创建维基文件夹并初始化配置。

say.text: 把这篇论文添加到我的量子计算维基中。
say.note: Claude 会将论文内容整理成页面并更新索引。
Claude 会显示已创建的维基列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, organize, and query a persistent wiki knowledge base. Each wiki is a folder of Markdown pages with provenance and a full-text search index, recallable across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "start a wiki", "add to wiki", "compile a page", "wiki on X", or want a long-lived knowledge base.

say_en.text: Start a wiki on quantum computing with research flavor.
say_en.note: Claude creates the wiki folder and initializes config.

say_en.text: Add this paper to my quantum computing wiki.
say_en.note: Claude ingests the paper into a page and updates the index.
Claude shows the list of existing wikis.
